source.from: Continue's OpenAI provider (github.com/continuedev/continue, core/llm/llms/OpenAI.ts) posts the OpenAI chat shape of parsers/openai/testdata/documented/chat-string.json to the provider's chat completions endpoint from VS Code's extension host

expect.why: Continue runs in Code.exe, an editor's process, which names no request, so the request is named by the host its config sends to (here api.openai.com, app:openai_api); Continue has no host of its own
